title: Memorandum of association (company limited by shares)
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Corporate Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every section of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 cited.

parts.text:
THE FEDERAL REPUBLIC OF NIGERIA
THE COMPANIES AND ALLIED MATTERS ACT 2020
MEMORANDUM OF ASSOCIATION
OF
{{companyName}}
parts.why: The statutory heading and the company's name. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: 1. The name of the Company is {{companyName}}.
parts.why: The name clause; it must end with 'Limited' for a private company limited by shares (or 'Plc' for a public company). Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: 2. The registered office of the Company shall be situated in Nigeria.
parts.why: The registered office clause: the memorandum states only that the office is in Nigeria. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

The objects clause: the principal object, objects in pursuance of it, and the independent objects declaration. A favourite in the Bar Part II exam. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The status clause: private or public. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: 5. The liability of the members is limited by shares.
parts.why: The liability clause. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: 6. The issued share capital of the Company is {{shareCapital}} divided into {{numberOfShares}} ordinary shares of {{shareValue}} each, with such rights as are defined by the Articles of Association registered with this Memorandum.
parts.why: The share capital clause: the issued capital, the number and value of shares. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
We, the several persons whose names and addresses are subscribed, are desirous of being formed into a company in pursuance of this Memorandum of Association, and we respectively agree to take the number of shares in the capital of the Company set opposite our respective names.

NAME AND ADDRESS OF SUBSCRIBER | DESCRIPTION | NUMBER OF SHARES TAKEN | SIGNATURE
#. {{subscribers}} | {{subscriberShares}} | ............

Total shares taken: ............
parts.why: The subscription clause and box: each subscriber's name, address, description, shares taken and signature. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

Dated, with the attestation of a witness to the subscribers' signatures. Where the facts leave details out, still fill the compulsory parts. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Company name
fields.question: What is the proposed company name? For example: New Spring Nigeria Limited.

fields.label: Principal object
fields.question: What is the company's main business?

fields.label: Other objects
fields.question: What other activities will it carry on in pursuance of the principal object?

fields.label: Status
fields.question: Is it a private or a public company?

fields.label: Issued share capital
fields.question: What is the issued share capital?

fields.label: Number of shares
fields.question: Into how many shares is it divided?

fields.label: Value of each share
fields.question: What is the value of each share?

fields.label: Subscribers
fields.question: Each subscriber's name, address and description.

fields.label: Shares taken
fields.question: The number of shares each subscriber takes, in the same order.
